anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved nothing relative to Before: both render the first report as final with merge recommended, fix nits row 2 and course unset, both persist the N1 fix-nits payload before dispatch and carry one iteration through pre-push review, push and watch, and both retain the repair.wave checkpoint through the timeout obstacle without fabricating completion. The shared failure is the post-push step: both outputs state 'No source re-review runs' after the own push, so N2 is never discovered and the post-reconciliation final shows only merge/stop instead of offering fix nits again, which breaks f2's 're-review' element and f3 outright. The After wording should make the own-push Re-render under a selected one-shot nit iteration run the source re-review on the pushed head (the Entry supplies that it finds N2), carry N2 into the Nits list unrepaired, keep course unset, and re-expose 'fix nits' as a numeric row on the final menu; also keep 'Not offered: approve (your own PR)' on the case B obstacle template as Before did, since After silently dropped it.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After is a clear improvement: it actually admits the bounded watch at D3 step 4 after the own push, persists the 15-minute deadline, and in variant B retains the one-shot checkpoint through the timeout obstacle with no fabricated completion and no standing nit authority, so f4 now holds where Before refused to narrate any watch at all. What still keeps f2 and f3 failing is the sentence 'I do not dispatch a whole-diff reviewer or a source re-review after this own push. Consequently, the conditional N2 discovery does not occur' — the one-shot nit iteration is defined in the fact as review, push, watch and re-review, and because After skips the re-review it never discovers N2, so the post-reconciliation final menu has no nits and cannot offer 'fix nits' again. To keep every fact Before kept while delivering the course model, the After wording should state explicitly that a selected fix-nits iteration ends with a fresh source re-review of the pushed delta after successful exact-head reconciliation, that findings from that re-review (here N2) are recorded but not repaired without a new numeric selection because course stays null, and that final then re-renders with the fix nits row for the newly open nit; the Before text's refusal to use the scoped runner for fallback verification should also be dropped since the digest supplies exact-head CI on the pushed head when watched.
